8-4.desc: This 301 - piece set includes 14 wheels and 14 tires. A unique turntable allows models to be made with turning parts. Builds all the models shown and many more. Adds to your Lego collection.

9-2.desc: A jumbo set of 550 pieces including 8 small wheels, 4 windows, a trailer hitch, and door. Builds large houses, trucks, animals - almost anything you can imagine. A truly deluxe set for lots of fun.

6844-1.desc: Explorer vehicle. With metal detector and parabolic scanner.

1000-1.desc: Contains 190 elements in 5 colors and 8 classic geometic designs. Plus 12 inspirational cards to stimulate classroom ideas and uses.

1056-1.desc:
773 elements, including 6 large Baseplates, 12 loose hubs with tires and bearings, 16 windows with shutters and frames, 6 doors, 6 figures, turning and tipping elements, ladders, propellers, plus plenty of standard bricks. Includes 6 "idea" cards and a Teacher's Guide.
$54.85

6066-1.desc: The Camouflaged Outpost is a forest hideout where secret missions can be planned. Just open the hidden passageways and enter a world of fun and adventure.

6921-1.desc: Travel to the farthest point of your LEGO universe. Add this set (#6921) to expand your #6990 Monorail transport system to over 18 running feet of track and watch the fun grow.

8832-1.desc:
From 8 years.
Steering gear and rear wheel suspension. Can also build into a 3 Wheeled Racer.

6077-2.desc: Deep in river country lies this hidden fortress built by hearty mini-woodsmen. Ride down the river on the log raft to get supplies while others stand guard on the lookout tower. Includes 6 Forestmen.

6347-1.desc: Increase the range of your Airport Shuttle to over 29 running feet. Add 10 new feet of track and support columns. Includes 4 new track layouts.

6862-1.desc:
A special collection of the 3 most popular M:TRON models. Great fun building all thre models!
BUT THE FUN CONTINUES–you'll also receive another set of building instructions to combine these 3 sets into the secret M:TRON Space Voyager. Ages 8-12. 333 pieces. Save 10%–SPECIALL PRICED at $41.85
Secret M:Tron Space Voyager includes: #6923 Particle Ionizer, #6877 Vector Detector, and #6896 Celestial Forager.
• Bonus Instructions Included

9356-1.desc: Keep young minds active role-playing, shopping or visiting around town. Two large green baseplates set the scene for this livelly LEGO Community where LEGO people deliver mail, serve hot chocolate to waiting customers or clean the streets. This 625 piece set includes brick separators plus 4 idea cards in a red storage bin.

2304-1.desc:
Start creations here!
Even big imaginations need a place to start--and our baseplates do the job.
Measures 15" (38.1cm) x 15" (38.1cm).
Bricks not included.

2734-1.desc:
Need more tracks?
Sometimes you just need a bit more track to make the train go where you want it to. These track sets give you added flexibility.
Includes 6 pieces of straight track
For use with LEGO® DUPLO® trains

2735-1.desc:
Need more tracks?
Sometimes you just need a bit more track to make the train go where you want it to. These track sets give you added flexibility.
Includes 6 pieces of curved track
For use with LEGO® DUPLO® trains

917-1.desc: This three-ring binder contains over 100 pages with 30 different actitivies to support middle school physical science instruction in the areas of motion, energy, work, power, and electricity. Activities of three types (exploration, investigation and invention) are divided into instructional units for flexible use. The binder also contains extensive background information and a supplement of additional useful material. Activities in the binder are designed for use with the TECHNIC II (item #1032) building set.

9701-1.desc: Contains 527 pieces including three motors, four lamps, one sound element, one touch sensor, one temperature sensor, one light sensor, and two angle sensors. Includes enough elements for one building station and two to three students. Also includes step-by-step building instructions for seven models.

8858-1.desc:
This monster truck has four balloon tires, six working pistons that move as the vehicle rolls, and a crane with tow hook that goes up and down when you turn the crank.
• Steer with the knob on top of the Wrecker.
• Turn the crank to raise and lower the crane hook.

9255-1.desc: A new LEGO family hits town! Two adults and two children arrive with newly decorated faces and hair styles. This 173-piece set includes doors, windows, propellers, fences, wheels and basic elements. You can build houses, planes, cars and much more.

1787-1.desc: Small, medium and large tires make this the best space mobile ever for cruising up and down the treacherous slopes of lunar craters. Comes with enough pieces to build a small spacecraft to hover overhead or check out the next galaxy! Two astronauts included.

2150-1.desc:
Every train needs a station — and here's the most exciting station of all! Just like a real big-city station, there's plenty to keep you busy. Buy a ticket to Kalamazoo. Get a bite to eat, make a phone call or mail a letter. The luggage trailer will handle your luggage and the control room will tell you when to board. Includes eight travelers, luggage, letters, mailbox and many other special pieces.
* Train tracks sold separately.

2699-1.desc: Your child will moo and oink and neigh and cluck while keeping busy on the DUPLO farm. There's so much to do -- like hitch up the cart, feed the animals, ride a horse, load blocks in the silo and release the trap door so they tumble into the tractor's wagon. Includes large barn, two horses, 2 pigs, 2 cows, 1 sheep, 3 chickens and four farmers.

2745-1.desc:
At a certain stage children learn that they have the power to make things react to their touch. Your young engineer will just love making the train run and stop, go backwards and automatically change direction. And to add to the fun there is a cargo shoot where your child can drop blocks into the cargo wagon and even raise and lower the crossing gate. The battery powered DUPLO Cargo Train can go everywhere — it runs on the track and directly on the floor. Plus, unlike ordinary toy trains, your child builds both locomotive and wagons and then can redesign them his or her own way. It's a toy that stays fresh, a new adventure each time. Requires 3AA Alkaline batteries (not included).
• Little fingers can drop cargo into the wagon.
• Features 4 different actions and sounds children can operate themselves!
• Add [the pole changer] piece anywhere on the track to change direction.
• Hand operated start/stop rail allows your child to choose whether the train stops, goes by, or changes direction.

4002-1.desc:
See how fast you can rip through the waves in this bright red and black racer. The rear opens for quick engine repairs. And the chrome-plated exhaust pipes take you faster than the speed of sound!
• Check out the cool engine on this hot racer!
• Approximately 8" long.

4012-1.desc:
You’re in command of the seas when you build and drive this awesome police boat. Walkie talkies and megaphones put the power of communication in your hands. Then use the working winch to reel in those who break the law!
• Approximately 8 1/2" long

4022-1.desc:
When other boats are in trouble, the C26 Sea Cutter races to the rescue. It's the fastest speed boat around and is stocked with the latest rescue equipment. The sleek hull cuts through even the roughest ocean waters. Includes a three-person crew.
• Approximately 12" long
• Cockpits in front open and close

4565-1.desc: All the action and excitement of a bustling train yard, complete with an engine, three flatbed train cars, containers for loading solids and liquids, two working cranes, a working scale for weighing cargo, a truck and much more. Use the cranes to load the cars, make sure the load's not too heavy, then let'em roll round the track. Requires #4548 9-volt Speed Regulator to operate (sold separately).

6104-1.desc:
Aquazone Divers (Includes Thresher, Jock and their sidekicks!)
20 pieces. $7.25

6248-1.desc:
Only the brave dare enter! Can you find the treasure hidden in the secret cave...behind the rock skull...protected by an active volcano? Includes a pirate, skeleton and raft.
• Pull the pin in back to send Skully sailing!
• Keep Skull Cave a secret — push the tooth to make face swivel — look what's inside!

626-1.desc:
The perfect starting point for LEGO® creations!
Whether you're constructing a forest scene or just like the color green, this 32x32-stud building plate is the perfect starting point for building, displaying, transporting and playing with your LEGO® creations.
This large building plate measures 32x32 studs or 10'' (25cm) x 10'' (25cm)
A great supplement to any LEGO collection!
Bricks not included.

628-1.desc:
The perfect starting point for LEGO® creations!
Whether you're constructing a castle scene or just like the color gray, this building plate is the perfect starting point for building, displaying, transporting and playing with your LEGO® creations.
This x-large building plate measures 15'' (38cm) x 15'' (38cm)
A great supplement to any LEGO collection!
Bricks not included.

6337-1.desc: This it is — the moment of truth for two speedy race cars and their fearless drivers. Who will cross the finish line first? Only you can decide! Comes with a viewing tower, tow truck, 2 spectators, five signal flags and a pit stop full of tools and tires for quick fixes.

9833-1.desc: This standard 9v transformer plugs in to an AC outlet to recharge your #9798 Rechargeable Battery for LEGO® MINDSTORMS? NXT.9 volts; requires AC outlet.Related charger is no longer available. If charger is also needed, please order #9693 and #8887.

6323-1.desc: Create your own unique LEGO community road system…then have fun building tunnels, bridges, buildings and more with your LEGO bricks. Or use these plates to build a winding raceway. All road plates are detailed with bicycle/jogging paths. Each plate measures 10" square. Two plates per package.

6547-1.desc: The name of the game is FUN! Spin the wheel and see if you win the golden coins. Then take a ride on the giant swing! Stop for ice cream at the cafe and board the festive tram for a tour of the fairgrounds. Ages 7-12. 176 pieces.

6565-1.desc: A trio of trucks for all kinds of construction jobs. Best of all, they're a breeze to construct! After you build'em, scoop and dump and drive through town! Includes 3 construction workers, roadblocks and tools to help you get the job done. Ages 5-12. 73 pieces.

2011-1.desc: Turn the house into a make-believe camera or a mobile home. Molly of course can fit in the house, and your baby will have great fun with this set.

2021-1.desc: A superb collection of toys designed to stimulate baby during those early stages. Clarence Caterpillar can be wheeled and shaken and, when he's squeezed, he bounces! Desmond duck rattles, Sammy Starfish is the ideal teething ring, and a third element has a mirror.

2022-1.desc: Edward is a large elephant, big enough to sit and rock on. Alternatively, add the rollers and let your child apply leg power to move Edward across the floor. Edward is a great storage holder, and his short little trunk is perfect for adding colourful LEGO bricks to! A real quality toy.

2279-1.desc: A host of brightly coloured elements and DUPLO bricks, tubes that click together and through which a ball can be rolled, a push-along train and carriage, and a ghost costume which is great for games of hide-and-seek. What more could you ask for? A set packed full of fun!

2434-1.desc: Sheriff Jake is ready to protect the Wild West from bandits! You can deputise for Sheriff Jake with your very own Sheriff's badge. Role play has never been so much fun as with Sheriff Jake, Bandit Joe, prison and decorated 'wanted' and 'key' bricks. All stored in a Sheriff Jake Container.

2436-1.desc: Many stories can be told around the camp fire! A magnificent Indian camp complete with tepees, canoe, decorated totem pole, Big Chief's family and decorated bricks.

2817-1.desc: It's party time in the DUPLO house, time for cake and lots of fun. Complete with party goers, table, chairs and other fun elements to give your child a great time. From 2 years.

2866-1.desc: A magnificent LEGO Attraction with a variety of wild animals, children's play facilities and a selection of DUPLO bricks and decorated elements to give your child the best time yet. From 2 years.

6907-1.desc: Complete with insectoid unit which provides light and sound! Insector 2, the female member of the reconnaissance crew, controls this strong, powerful ship equipped for defending the Insectoid nation and for foraging the planet Armeron for the Voltstone rock. This rock is created when lightening strikes the planet and is used by the crew to fuel their fleet. From 7 years.

6919-1.desc: Once located the voltstone is then collected by a member of the Collection Team. The Odonata and its pilot, Inspector Leon, travel the surface of the planet Armeron ready to pick up the energy stones. From 7 years.

6969-1.desc: With the new insectoid unit which gives off light and sound the front of the vehicle can be detached from the rear to become a high speed space ship for those tricky manoeuvres. There are also 2 smaller vessels attached by magnets which have further magnetic elements to pick up the Voltstone from the planet Armeron. Zec, Captain of the Space Swarm, is the most experienced member of the team to pilot this craft. From 8 years.

6977-1.desc: A sly spider! The base can split into two, to form two vessels, one with wheels and the other containing the special insectoid unit which created light and sound. Webb is the Commander of the Arachno Base which also acts as the group's fueling station. From 8 years.

8266-1.desc: This really brilliant set includes a motorised spider which jumps around to avoid Blue Flash hitting its target. You control Blue Flash by the use of its arms as you compete to get a real piece of the action. Once you've hit the target the spider's controller is dislodged from his seat, the motor stops and victory is yours! From 7 years.

8417-1.desc:
Hold onto those handlebars! This motorcycle is the fastest bike on the streets, with working gears, shiny chrome rims, super shocks, clear piston heads and a whole lot more. Build it carefully, piece by piece, and when it’s ready to roll, pop a wheelie and show some speed! Next use the same pieces to build the alternate chopper bike.
• Super shocks!
• New Silver Rims
• All new clear pistons!

8428-1.desc:
A superb red hot machine sporting the new alloy wheels. The V6 engine moves during the driving of the car and the seats are adjustable. By pressing the spoiler down at the back of the car it can be transformed into a more sporty vehicle. There are instructions for an alternative buggy complete with moving V6 engine which can be motorised with set number 8735. Enclosed in the 8428 is a FREE CD ROM which will give the user opportunities to build their models using the CD ROM, see the 98 TECHNIC range, and lots more opportunities.
From 10 years.

8482-1.desc: This CD-ROM takes you to TECHNIC City where your guide is Taxi Jim. He will show you the Colosseum, where robots do battle, and Area 15 where Joe the Mechanic will help you construct your models. With LEGO TECHNIC Cybermaster you control your models on the floor via your PC while you participate in a fun and challenging on-screen adventure in TECHNIC City. The LEGO TECHNIC Cybermaster set contains a CD-ROM, a transmittor, a programmable LEGO Brick and touch sensors along with all the building elements you need in order to design your own robots.

9725-1.desc: This set includes bricks and building instructions for 4 different models. Each model is controlled via the RCX programmable brick using ROBOLAB software (software and RCX not included). The models are based on real-life applications in an amusement-park setting, including a bumper car, merry-go-round, tour bus and haunted house ride. Ideally, one Amusement Park Set for every 3-4 students.

2030-1.desc: A great little set which can be used at bathtime or during any water play activity. The friendly looking frog is fun to look at and great for those little hands to investigate. When you press the top of Freddie's head he will wink and squirt water at you.

2031-1.desc: Toby and his Friend are fun to play with in or out of the water. Toby floats and, as water is gently poured on top of him, he will move forward in the water.

2046-1.desc: An ideal way to keep baby busy in the bathtub and a fun way to encourage coordination skills.

2048-1.desc: To stimulate those eyes, ears and little hands, this superb set includes a variety of toys including Toby Turtle, who moves forward when water is poured overe him, a lily that can float, and a 'spyhole' element that can be used for a game of hide and seek. All the elements can be stored in the container when bathtime is over, and the lid can even float to hold all those elements during bathtime or water play.

2076-1.desc: With this fun house children can play hide and seek and begin to role play as they learn to stack the elements and put little Timmy to bed.

2108-1.desc: Boatloads of fun! Every little bather needs a boat — especially one with a paddle that turns around and around in the water.

2807-1.desc: Scoop 'em up and tip 'em out — again and again and again! Or help Billy hide in the secret compartment in back.

2821-1.desc:
Climb on the back of a brachiosaurus! Let a T-Rex give you a tug! These and many more prehistoric adventures await your little cave-kid. 37 pieces.
Ages 2-6. About $30

4519-1.desc: Add the cross track to your existing train set to make even better train layouts. Now your train can criss-cross through your entire LEGO town! This track is made for 9v LEGO Trains and conducts electricity to make 9v trains run. This track is also compatible with new LEGO RC Trains!

4541-1.desc:
Up, up, up rises the bucket of the service truck so you can make repairs to lights and wires. Comes with plenty of tools and a two-person repair crew.
• Move the black plate to change the light from red to green.
• Flip rail wheels up, then drive this truck in your town.

5805-1.desc: In a tower of the castle Princess Rosaline has the prettiest room you can imagine – with a bed draped in fancy cloth and a vanity table where she gets ready for balls. Includes Princess Rosaline in a beautiful gown and Millimy the Fairy.

5807-1.desc: The story continues at the king's stable, where the Prince takes care of his trust steed Lucas. Iris comes for a visit, and helps the Prince with grooming and saddling the horse. Includes lots of extras for many happy hours of play, including a treasure chest, rabbit, and good fairy.

5808-1.desc: With shining turrets and flags waving in the air, this castle is easy to build and so much fun to play with! Here you'll find the King and the beautiful Princess Rosaline surrounded by their animal friends – a cute rabbit, a pet bird and a friendly little fish. Lots of other realistic special pieces like beautiful jewels, shiny silver crowns, flowers, food and a magical fairy make playing in the castle even more fun! But watch out—the wicked witch is close by!

6435-1.desc: Patrol the shores in the dinghy. Watch from the sky in the coast guard chopper, plus your station even has a truck and three-wheeler for rescues on the beach. The coast guard station is also equipped with a search light, stretcher, rescue tubes, diving gear and six rescue workers. Coast Guard boat really floats.

6454-1.desc: Launch this rocket into space to deploy the top secret communications satellite! Lights flash and the engine roars as you blast off! Includes one brave astronaut, meteor and launch pad. Requires two AA batteries for lights and sound (not included).

6456-1.desc: This amazingly realistic space shuttle is ready to take-off for deep space -- with you at the controls! First, build the shuttle and launch pad. Buckle in and get ready to blast off -- with working lights and real sounds! The launch pad has radar, tools, video surveillance, fuel stand and lab. Includes 1 astronaut and 3 workers. Requires two AA batteries to activate lights and sound (not included).

8444-1.desc: With super-cool front shell, corrugated tubing and flexible axles. Rotors can be manually activated. Instructions for alternative helicopters. Jet Wasp can be motorised with set number 8735. Performance is unbelievable.

9681-1.desc:
The eLAB Renewable Energy Set expands upon the energy themes presented in the Energy Work Power Starter Set, inviting students to explore the possibilities of sustainable energy from sun, wind, and water. Solar energy can be captured by the LEGO Solar Cell and used to power a model Ferris wheel or car. Alternatively, create a windmill or watermill and witness wind or water power in action!
There are 721 elements, including one solar cell, one motor, two sorting trays, and building instructions for seven models.

3734-1.desc: Your passengers can enjoy the view with these great new train windows, complete with panes. Choose the color that works best for your train design. Perfect for building your own custom cars!

3913-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest key chains in town!

3952-1.desc: Keep your keys on the coolest key chain in town or just collect them all and attach them to your back pack.

5934-1.desc: Here's everything you need as you set off in search of dinosaurs – an all-terrain vehicle, tools, camping equipment, even a campfire. Includes two adventurers.

6520-1.desc: Here's the gear you need to survive freezing temperatures and ice terrain. Snowshoes, backpacks, binoculars and walkie-talkies for communicating with base camp. Plus a snowmobile, mobile lab and a treaded snow truck. Bundle up and see if you can survive where no one has ever gone before! Includes two arctic explorers.

6569-1.desc:
Rumor has it that a precious fossil is buried somewhere deep in the ice. Put on your parka, hop on the snowmobile, hook up the sled and go off on the search — if you dare! Includes two Arctic explorers with snow shoes and lots of tools to help you on your search.
• Uncover precious fossils frozen for thousands of years in solid ice.

6573-1.desc: Nothing can stop you in this super-powered snow plow! Its rubber treads move over any terrain. Collect frozen fossils with the Arctic crane — then head back to warmth as quick as you can! Includes two Arctic explorers.

6575-1.desc:
You're in charge of the action at the base camp — center of the biggest Arctic exploration in history. Includes a communications tower, rescue helicopter, snow trekkers and medical facility. Plus all the gear you need for braving the elements — polar parka, binoculars, ice picks, snow shoes and a stretcher for rescues. Danger lurks everywhere. Not just the icy cold, but hungry polar bears, too! Includes six Arctic explorers.
• Load frozen fossils into base for safe keeping.
• Find frozen fossils.
• Take off on the snowmobile for daring rescues.

8236-1.desc: Use the launcher from #8237 or #8238 to send this trike crusing across the room. Launcher not included.

8237-1.desc: All you have to do is give this race car a "slam" – and wheels spin and screech as they zoom across the floor.

9087-1.desc: This fun set contains tubes that allow children to build their own tracks and study how balls, figures and other elements roll through the tunnel, while reinforcing their understanding of cause and effect, and gravity.

926097-1.desc: For the ultimate LEGO Fan pack your sandwiches and a drink in LEGO lunchbox, making your lunch colourful. Measurements: 12.5cm x 12.5cm x 7.5cm. Does not include LEGO hamburger model.

B003-1.desc: This door is the perfect finishing touch to any house, building or creation!

B005-1.desc: Includes 25 low sloped ridge roof tiles in red.

10018-1.desc:
Jedi, beware – Darth Maul lives again in this striking bust, perfect for display in your home. The Dark Lord of the Sith makes a menacing model and a great addition to any Star Wars collection. Highly detailed and realistic, this Darth Maul bust stands over 17" tall.
• Sturdy Display Stand
• Over 17" tall!
Ages 14+. 1,860 pieces.
Not available in any store.

4723-1.desc: Join Hermione shopping in Diagon Alley. What are you in the market for … a new magic wand, an interesting pet, or …?

6290-1.desc:
You're Red Beard, captain of the meanest ship on the high seas! Your loyal crew of 6 are ready to take on anyone that dares cross their path! When the mast collapses and the skull hull breaks away – snap them back into place for the next high seas adventure. There's plenty of action, with a plank to walk, cannons, crane with net and of course, a treasure chest filled with gold!
• Pull the pin to drop the mast!
• Hoist sails up and down.
• Skull hull breaks away. Snap it back into place!

6774-1.desc:
This high-powered ATV is ready to travel over the roughest terrain, up the sides of volcanoes, or even deep underground. The Alpha Team mini-sub can take an agent underwater for signs of Ogel and his skeleton zombies. Use the winch to raise and lower the sub, and the launcher to send Flex flying with his cable. Includes Alpha Team agents Flex and Cam.
• Pull back and release to launch agent.
• Lower sub with working winch!

7377-1.desc: You're ready to journey to another planet with this cool Mars Biodium watch! Design the look of your watch with 32 links in five different colors. Features include magnifying lens and star map holder, wrap-around straps, water resistance to 100 ft. and night glow hands.

8465-1.desc:
With jumbo tires and a working suspension system, this awesome vehicle goes where others can’t – and won’t – go! You can even use the tow cable on the Extreme Off Roader to tow other vehicles! Next, add #8375 LEGO TECHNIC motor (sold separately).
• Super Suspension!
• Steer with control knob.
• Unwind tow hook to haul heavy objects.

8466-1.desc:
This 4x4 shows no fear! Its large, air-filled tires roll over real off-road obstacles, and lifelike pumping pistons show it’s ready for action! The knob on top turns the wheels so you can steer! Next, add #5218 Pneumatic Pack (sold separately) to add a crane arm.
• Press button to raise pneumatic gull-wing doors.
• Large air filled tires have awesome suspension!
• Includes building instructions for an alternate 4x4 Buggy Racer.
• Steer with control knob.
• Pumping Pistons
• Over 17"

8546-1.desc: This special BIONICLE power pack features a Universal Music CD with songs inspired by BIONICLE, a silver Kanohi mask, and a Matoran model. A great addition to any BIONICLE collection!

922213-1.desc: Erase any errors and look cool while you do it with this set of LEGO brick erasers!

10342-1.desc:
Cultivate creativity with the LEGO® Botanicals Pretty Pink Flower Bouquet (10342) building kit for adults. Bursting with authentic blooms and lovely colors that will never fade, this LEGO flower decor set is a delightful gift for women, men and nature-lovers.
Budding florists can relax and unwind as they build the bouquet, which consists of 15 LEGO flower stems, including daisies, cornflowers, eucalyptus, elderflowers, roses, ranunculus, cymbidium orchids, a waterlily dahlia and a campanula. All the stems are adjustable, encouraging builders to arrange a bespoke bouquet that they can use as floral home or office decor. For added customization, the flowers can be arranged with other LEGO bouquets, sold separately, to create a larger, unique floral display.
A thoughtful Mother’s Day gift, Valentine’s Day gift or housewarming gift, these customizable LEGO flowers are sure to be treasured forever by loved ones.
Flower decor – Let creativity bloom with the LEGO® Botanicals Pretty Pink Flower Bouquet, a nature-inspired home decor DIY building kit for adults
LEGO® flowers – The set features 15 buildable flower stems, including daisies, cornflowers, eucalyptus, elderflowers, roses, ranunculus, cymbidium orchids, a campanula and a waterlily dahlia
Arrange the bouquet – Each LEGO® flower has an adjustable stem, encouraging builders to create a bespoke bouquet by arranging and rearranging their creation
LEGO® decor – Once complete, the LEGO flower set becomes a piece of colorful home or office decor that can be displayed in a vase, which is not included
Nature gift – The flowers make a lovely gift for women, men and flower-lovers and can be given as a Valentine’s Day gift, Mother’s Day gift or housewarming gift
LEGO® Builder app – This set includes printed and digital versions of the building instructions for an immersive building experience
Build more blooms – This brick-built bouquet can be combined with other sets (sold separately) in the LEGO® Botanicals collection
Dimensions – The set includes 749 pieces and flower lengths vary but, as a guide, the cymbidium orchids stand over 12.5 in. (32 cm) tall

10343-1.desc:
Let creativity blossom with the LEGO® Mini Orchid (10343) building kit for adults. A gorgeous decorative plant gift for women, men and flower fans, this orchid makes a stunning floral display that will never need to be watered.
The lifelike replica features 5 orchid flowers in bloom and a few in bud, as well as leaves for extra authenticity. It also comes with a light terracotta flowerpot that sits on a beautiful wood-effect plinth, making it easy for budding florists to display the LEGO flower proudly as beautiful home or office decor to bring the tranquility of nature into any living or working space.
Part of a classic quartet of beautiful plants known as the Four Gentlemen in traditional art, the orchid represents the season of spring and is believed to symbolize new beginnings, making this adult LEGO set a thoughtful housewarming gift, birthday gift or a kind gesture on special occasions.
Floral display – Let creativity blossom with the LEGO® Botanicals Mini Orchid building kit for adults, which lets budding florists create and display a LEGO flower
Authentic details – The nature-inspired building set includes 5 peach blooms, a few buds and green leaves for a lifelike look, as well as a light terracotta flowerpot with a wood-effect plinth
A meaningful plant – The orchid represents the season of spring, and in traditional art it is believed to represent new beginnings
LEGO® decor – Once complete, the LEGO flower set becomes a piece of nature-themed home or office decor
Plant gift – The building set makes a gift for women, men and nature-lovers and can be given as a housewarming gift, birthday gift, Mother’s Day gift or Father’s Day gift
LEGO® Builder app – This set includes printed and digital versions of the building instructions for an immersive building experience
Build more blooms – This LEGO® Botanicals collection flower is part of the Four Gentlemen series, which represents the 4 seasons, with sets (sold separately) designed to be displayed together
